learning_outcomes.text: Comprehends matter and its properties, the structure of the atom, and the periodic system.
Comprehends chemical bonds based on electron configurations of atoms and constructs Lewis structures.
Completes chemical reactions and performs calculations related to them.
Comprehends and applies the distinguishing properties of gases, liquids, and solids.
Applies experiments such as solution preparation and titration in the laboratory, interprets and reports their results.
Comprehends and calculates the reaction rate expression.
Comprehends reaction formations with the help of chemical equilibrium and kinetics topics.
Comprehends and calculates terms like chemical reaction heat or energy.
Comprehends basic electrochemistry information and performs related calculations.

syllabus_topics: Structure and Properties of the Atom
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 50% from in-term success and 50% from the final exam. In-term success is derived from a midterm exam (80%) and a performance task (laboratory) (20%).
